verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only general authentication: automatic OIDC on Vercel, development tokens via `vercel env pull`, and access tokens for non-Vercel environments. None of it describes issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. Per-agent Linux users are OS-level isolation, an adjacent control rather than scoped API credentials, and the generic platform access tokens are a host-platform capability with no documented scoping.
